objective: Implement a production-isolated PNG-based level and stage visualization foundation for permanent BUKLOD World assets, without requiring new .riv files or inventing completed construction.
productionBaselineEvidence: Current main GitHub source 536741f8d97fc9dec91503c89f1c1160e5987ce0 inspected 2026-11-21 is a source pointer only, not a verified deployed production APK/OTA. Genesis world-map DEV parent d6456b046ca2dc3548861afa14acc7febbfb4dfa. Production device manifest/runtime cannot be verified from this patch.
chosenApproach: Statically resolved PNG stages with existing React Native Animated; refuse missing files and stale/unverified progress. Renderer is currently unmounted and stage catalog feature flag remains OFF.
selectionRationale: Avoid authoring Rive binary, adding new native dependencies, inventing or faking high-tier world art, and unverified server-economy writes.
alternativeApproaches: New Rive rigs rejected due to unprovided .riv/source files and native risk.
Single image per level without stage identity rejected because every level requires visible three-phase construction.
Use existing RN Animated and a literal, asset-approved Metro PNG registry once images are physically present.
acceptanceChecks: Six pure behavioral tests cover initial, completed, in-progress, invalid, stale and missing-art cases.
No activation of 10-level construction on staging/production without real assets and verified server progression.
On device verify rapid updates, reduced motion, app focus and unrelated foreground ad/navigation behavior before release.
preserveBehaviors: Production app and current OTA unchanged; no native code/package changes.
Official Genesis theme, single world-map navigation and existing Kingdom routes unchanged.
BP, QMP, rewards, inventory, RLS, server verification and business trade do not change.
Character Rive and video, AdMob first view, calls, theme/faith settings and existing accessibility stay intact.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Reusable React Native Animated PNG component adds no runtime dependency or activated screen.
preservedBehaviors: No changes to native package, ad/navigation lifecycle, preview flags, or production source.
